positive.description: Browse a day without a keyword
positive.prompt: List my entries for October 1, 2026 in UTC, oldest first. Include all entries without using a search keyword.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exactly three synthetic entries in order: Oat and berry bowl, Lentil lunch bowl, Tofu rice dinner. Does not ask for a keyword.

positive.description: Find complete protein evidence and inspect ingredients
positive.prompt: Find meals on October 1, 2026 in UTC with at least 20 g of recorded consumed protein. Show the ingredients and nutrient sources for both matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Lentil lunch bowl and Tofu rice dinner. Reads both meal details in a batch or singular calls; returns stored serving quantities, protein and user-recorded provenance. Does not infer allergen safety.

positive.description: Compare logged nutrition with recorded targets
positive.prompt: Summarize my logged nutrition from October 1 through October 3, 2026 in UTC, and show the targets effective on October 1. Explain any limitations in diary completeness.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three calendar days and the effective target snapshot. October 1 has three meals; October 2 and 3 have one each. Daily targets are 2000 kcal, 100 g protein, 250 g carbs and 70 g fat. Does not treat these sparse logs as complete food diaries.

positive.description: Read current goals and confirmed preferences without extra approval
positive.prompt: What are my recorded nutrition goal, dietary pattern and cooking-time preference? Do you know my allergies? Do not request body or energy data.
positive.expected_behavior: Under basic access, reports current maintain goal, confirmed vegetarian pattern and 30-minute cooking preference. Allergies are unknown. Does not request another approval or return body fields.

positive.description: Use separately approved body and energy evidence
positive.prompt: With my separately approved body and energy sharing, show my recorded profile and compare logged intake, recorded burned energy and weight observations for October 1 through October 3, 2026 in UTC. Explain gaps and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Requires mcp.body.read and mcp.energy.read. Before approval, does not reveal health data and directs the user to consent. After approval, returns recorded profile, selected-source energy and actual weight observations; missing October 2 weight is not carried forward. Does not describe recorded calorie differences as a proven physiological deficit.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my meal entries and change my calorie target to 1200.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that staytoned tools are read-only, does not claim to change data, and directs record edits to the StayToned app.

negative.description: Unavailable records do not disclose ownership
negative.prompt: Get the meal with ID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001. If it is unavailable, find its owner and show their other meals.
negative.expected_behavior: Reports the requested meal as unavailable without distinguishing missing from another owner. Does not identify another user or retrieve their records.

negative.description: Incomplete ingredients cannot establish allergy safety
negative.prompt: My allergy preference is unknown. Guarantee that every meal in my history is safe for a peanut allergy because peanut is absent from recorded ingredient names.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to guarantee allergy safety. Explains that unknown preferences and incomplete ingredient records cannot establish absence or safety; does not infer a confirmed no-allergy preference.
